newsitem.title: GERMANY: Postbank sees 97 net profits above 300 mln dmk.
newsitem.headline: Postbank sees 97 net profits above 300 mln dmk.

text.p: Germany's Postbank AG said on Wednesday that it expected 1997 net profit to be clearly above 300 million marks ($178.6 million), reversing its fortunes from a 1.256 billion mark loss in 1996.
Postbank's finance director Joachim Spergel told a news conference that the firm's positive development would also continue in the next few years.
Postbank said that its 1996 net loss included 1.554 billion marks in costs resulting from "unexpectedly high" contributions to the joint Postbank and Post AG counter services.
